text:
Maya K: quick design review — the flow where you change a resource's region (and we surface KMS/retention impact) feels clunky. current modal says 'Changing region may affect encryption keys' — too vague.
Liam G: agreed. users need a clear two-part decision: 1) What happens to data retention and 2) What happens to key ownership. combine those? worried about modal length.
Sophia R: proposal: split into header + bullets + actions. header: 'Moving workspace region' bullet1: 'Retention policy may revert to region default (30 days) unless overridden' bullet2: 'Customer KMS keys cannot be moved — you must re-encrypt or provide a new key.' keep it scannable.
Oliver P: UX nit: use simpler language than "re-encrypt" — maybe "you’ll need to upload a new key or accept platform-managed encryption". also add small info icon linking to help center.
Maya K: accessibility note — screen readers read the modal as one long paragraph. we need aria-live regions and focus trap. Also add an explicit confirmation checkbox for "I understand the data will move and encryption settings may change" for destructive cases.
Sophia R: copy variants for CTA:
- Option A primary: "Proceed and Update Region"
- Option B primary: "Continue — Manage Keys Later"
- Danger action: "Cancel Move"
Which one is less ambiguous?
Liam G: "Continue — Manage Keys Later" sounds like you can delay addressing keys; might lead to accidental data exposure. prefer "Proceed and Keep Existing Keys (you'll re-encrypt manually)" — too long though.
Oliver P: maybe two-step: first modal for region change (confirm move). second inline banner after move: "Encryption keys missing in new region — re-encrypt now" with CTA "Add key" and secondary "Remind me later". avoids scary copy in the first modal.
Maya K: good point. second-step banner needs to be persistent in workspace UI and clearly show consequence (read-only access?) — is that a real consequence? we should avoid false threats.
Deploy Bot: deploy/preview updated modal copy to staging at 1842094400
Sophia R: accessibility copy tweak: add visible label for KMS status: instead of icon only, show text + aria-label: "KMS: customer-managed (not available in target region)".
Liam G: also check color contrast for the warning banner — current yellow fails AA on small text. bump to darker tone or use bold border + icon instead of relying on color alone.
Oliver P: audit log copy: when region change happens, log entry should include: actor, previous region, target region, retention override (if any), kms_action="key_missing" or "key_copied". copy should be human readable e.g. "Liam G moved workspace alpha from us-west to eu-central; retention defaulted to 30 days; customer KMS not available in target region." keep it short.
Maya K: dev request: add a minimal sample entry for designers to review in the Audit Log UI. also add filtering tag "region-change" so security teams can query easily.
Sophia R: one more accessibility nit: keyboard users need a clear escape path from modal. ensure Esc closes if no destructive confirmation required; if checkbox present, Esc should not bypass it.
Liam G: final ask for the implementation ticket: include copy options (short + detailed), ARIA attributes, contrast swatches, audit-log sample text, and two mock flow options (single modal vs modal + post-move banner).
Maya K: thanks — I'll consolidate into a PR comment with screenshots. tagging @Oliver P for frontend sizing estimates and @Sophia R for a11y review. :thumbsup:
